$comment: Extracted from Language Learning by Phrases/Loro.dc.html. See docs/design/design-system.md

sunken.comment: Inset areas, inactive chips, icon tiles

device.comment: Blueprint device bezel; not a product surface

dark.comment: The flat dark fill: dark cards, the toast, the active segmented-control track. Pair only with onDark.* text — being the lightest dark background, it is the worst case for contrast, so that is what the checker uses.

muted.deviation: #6c6759 was 4.41:1 on surface.sunken2 — the darkest light surface, which the contrast gate did not check until axe found the pairing rendered in the stream. Nudged along the same hue to clear 4.5:1 there

muted3.deviation: blueprint #8c8677 was 2.94:1 on surface.sunken — nudged to clear 3:1, then again from #8a8476 which was 2.91:1 on surface.sunken2

semantic.$comment: Each family is a triple — text, background, border. That triple is what makes the pills and banners work.

successMeta.use: Secondary line under a success headline ('It comes out without thinking now.'), on success.bg
successMeta.comment: Blueprint had #5f8a71 — 3.4:1 on success.bg, below AA. Darkened along the same hue to 4.55:1.

successAlt.comment: Blueprint had #3d7a5b, which passes on surface.app (4.7:1) but only reaches 4.4:1 on success.bg, where it is actually used. Nudged to 4.52:1.
successAlt.deviation: blueprint #3f7d5d was 4.37:1 — a check mark beside text reads as text

info.use: Pronunciation focus, Easy grade, Instant confidence

hookMeta.deviation: blueprint #bd9660 was 2.44:1 — genuinely unreadable at 10px. The largest correction in the palette.

scale.$comment: Four ordered scales. Their ORDER carries meaning, so it is part of the contract.

mastery.$deviation: new and learning were 2.29:1 and 2.46:1 on surface.app — too faint for the legend dots to be distinguishable. Darkened to clear 3:1.

warming.$comment: THE most important colour transition in the app. The Refrain card heats as automaticity climbs. Loro.dc.html:3392-3396

peak.deviation: the gradient's light stop was #e08a4a — white on it was 2.66:1, below even the 3:1 large-text floor. Darkened to #d28145.
constraint: WHITE TEXT ON THIS BAND MUST BE >=17px SEMIBOLD. It clears 3:1, not 4.5:1.
The blueprint renders a 13px English subtitle in white at 0.7 opacity here
(Loro.dc.html:1442). That does not pass, and darkening the gradient far enough
to fix it (#a86737 -> #8f4119) turns the app's single most important reward
So the constraint is recorded rather than waived: the peak card's secondary
text needs a different treatment. Tracked as Q-14 in docs/decisions/open-questions.md
and enforced by checkContrast.ts, which fails if this floor is removed.

onDark.$comment: Ink inverts to a warm grey ramp on dark cards. Loro.dc.html:49-52
